subject: AcreetionOS Update — June 10, 2026
body:
Our continuous integration pipeline just got a significant boost with the introduction of per-pipeline staging directories, which greatly reduces the likelihood of publish races between concurrent builds, ensuring that our users receive the latest ISO images in a timely and reliable manner. This change is a key step forward in maintaining the stability and integrity of our release process, and you can read more about the details of this improvement on our changelog page at https://acreetionos.org/changelog.html.

Development
The development team has been actively reviewing recent upstream activity around Arch Linux and related tools, and we're excited to see the latest developments, such as the release of Emacs 31.1, which is now available in our repositories. Our team is committed to keeping our users up-to-date with the latest software and security updates, and you can find more information about our development process on our wiki at https://acreetionos.org/wiki.html.

Community
We're grateful for the contributions of our community members, who have been actively sharing their experiences and configurations with AcreetionOS, such as the recent release of configs and field notes from a DL380 G7 running Arch. If you're looking for tips and guides on how to get the most out of AcreetionOS, be sure to check out our documentation page at https://acreetionos.org/docs.html, and don't forget to visit our flash page at https://acreetionos.org/flash.html for the latest news and updates.
